'''''Falko's Spear''''' was a battered [[wind rider]] owned by the minor [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ray Carantar]]. Carantar entered the ''Falko's Spear'' into the [[Festival of the High Winds]], the annual wind rider race on [[Sevarcos II]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Carantar's crew was replaced by a team of undercover [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s with the mission of rescuing Alliance [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Carter Escalon]] from a [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="FHW">{{JournalCite|12|Festival of High Winds}}</ref>
